column1: # Copied from otfabric/iec60870-5-interop tests/iec103/known-bugs.tsv at v0.4.0 (contract 2.3).
# Known bugs of upstream versions for IEC 60870-5-103, for scripts/interop.sh.
# Same columns and rules as tests/iec104/known-bugs.tsv. Every entry was seen
# on the wire in a run (docs/COMPATIBILITY.md has the frames); no issue was
# filed upstream, so the URL is the source line at the pinned commit.

column4: Iec103Server answers a general interrogation with cause 11 instead of 9, and its ASDU 1 has DPI, four octets FF and a CP56Time2a (12 octets) instead of DPI, CP32Time2a and SIN (6 octets), so no SIN carries the scan number

Iec103Server confirms a general command with ASDU 1 cause 11 (a refusal with the P/N bit: 139) and the 12-octet elements, never with cause 20 or 21 and the RII as SIN, and sends no change of state with cause 12 (clause 7.4.4; its Cot103 has 11 and 12 swapped); it takes a command for every indication, not only the fixture's commands

After a reset of the communication unit Iec103Server sends two ASDU 5 (function type 255, INF 80 with cause 4 and INF 81 with cause 5) of eight ASCII characters only: no compatibility level, no software identification, and INF 80 instead of 3

Iec103AsduBuilder.ClockSynchronization sends ASDU 6 with a CP32Time2a and one zero octet (5 octets) instead of a CP56Time2a (7 octets); a station that checks the length ignores it and sends no confirmation

Iec103AsduBuilder.GeneralCommand sends ASDU 20 without the return information identifier (14 81 14 01 A0 63 02: type, VSQ, cause, CA, FUN, INF, DCO; clause 7.3.2.4 has DCO and RII), which a station that checks the length drops, so no confirmation comes; one that takes it has no RII to return as SIN

IEC8705103Manager::CommandTrasmission sends a general command only when its INF is typical in table 17 for the function type the station identified with (160: 16..19; 128: any; 255, as vitusdong identifies: none), although the FUN column is typical, not mandatory (clause 7.2.5.2); otherwise it sends nothing (error failed), e.g. for 160/23
